record.title: Milak–Zaranj August 2021 security closure and phased freight restoration
record.direction: Crossing traffic both directions; detailed direction-specific prohibitions not established
record.movement: Milak passengers and goods transit, including Chabahar-linked cargo
record.exceptions: Passengers reportedly restored August 10; August 11 plan covered already-stranded trucks. Dogharoun and Mahiroud trade continued.
record.imposing_authority: Iranian border/customs authorities; original closure instrument not retrieved
record.enforcement: IRICA spokesman describes staged release; port official reports actual freight resumption.
record.relationship: Distinct August 2021 Milak event, not July 2021 R2-SC-012/R3-SC-009 or May 2023 CC023.
record.status_observation: Freight resumption on August 15 reported August 23, 2021.
record.official_rationale: Officials attributed closure to insecurity near the frontier amid events in Afghanistan.
record.context: Separate from July Dogharoun/Mahiroud interruption and May 2023 Milak clashes.
record.uncertainty: August 5/6 onset discrepancy retained. August 11 headline says reopens but text is a plan; no actual August 11 endpoint inferred. August 15 actual claim is a Mehr reproduction quoting a port official, not independent field observation.

historical.duration_note: No supported continuous operational interval for the stated scope. No measured continuous interval is established.
